transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Jasmine. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jasmine. I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. To get started, I'll need to verify your account for security purposes. Do you have your Customer ID number handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, hold on a second... let me find it. Okay, it's CUST-1018.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And could you please confirm the full name on the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: David Gonzalez.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And for the final verification step, can you provide the 4-digit security PIN associated with your account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Gonzalez. I've successfully verified your account. Now, how can I assist you with your bill today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, I added a new line to my plan last month for my son. When I did it, the representative told me the activation fee would be waived.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I just got my new bill yesterday, and there's a $35 activation fee right there on the first page. I was told it wouldn't be there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand your concern, Mr. Gonzalez. It's frustrating to see a charge you weren't expecting. I sincerely apologize for any confusion this has caused. Let me pull up your latest bill and take a look at that for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just one moment while the system loads your billing statement... Okay, I have it here.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You see it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I see the invoice dated for this month, and I can confirm there is a line item listed as 'New Line Activation Fee' for $35.00.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. And it shouldn't be there. The person I spoke to promised it would be waived.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. What I'd like to do next is review the notes from your previous call when you added the line. That will tell me about the promotion that was offered. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold for about a minute or two while I investigate that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, no problem. Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you so much. I'll be back with you shortly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mr. Gonzalez? Thank you for your patience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so I have the notes from your call on the 15th of last month. It looks like you spoke with my colleague, Alex.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds right. He was very helpful, actually.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad to hear that. And I'm reviewing his notes now... just reading through the details of the new line setup...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ah, yes. I see it right here. The notes clearly state, 'Customer eligible for waived activation fee promo. To be applied as a bill credit on the next cycle.'

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, good! So you see it. I was worried I was going crazy or misremembered the conversation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all, you remembered correctly. It seems the system did not automatically apply the credit as it was supposed to. This was definitely our error, and I sincerely apologize for the oversight.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, as long as we can get it fixed, that's all that matters.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I am going to apply that credit for you right now. It's a simple fix from my end.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm processing a one-time credit for the full amount of the fee, which is $35.00.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, I need to explain how this will appear. Because your current billing cycle has already closed and the invoice has been generated, we can't alter the bill that you have now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So... what does that mean? Do I still have to pay it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the total amount on your current bill is still due by the date listed. However, the $35 credit I'm applying will sit on your account and will automatically be used to reduce the total of your *next* month's bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, okay. So I pay this one in full, and next month's bill will be $35 cheaper? Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is exactly right. You'll essentially be reimbursed on the next billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I guess that's fine. It's a bit confusing, but as long as I get the money back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand, and I apologize for the extra step. It's just a limitation of how the billing system works once an invoice is finalized. I've just finished applying the credit to your account now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The credit is confirmed. For your records, would you like a reference number for this transaction?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. That would be great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly. The reference number is CR, as in credit, dash, 8-8-1, dash, 9-2-3-4.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, CR-881-9234. Got it. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. I'm happy I was able to find the source of the issue and get it resolved for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. I appreciate your help, Jasmine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. While I have you on the line, Mr. Gonzalez, is there anything else I can assist you with today? Any other questions about your plan or services from Cymbal Telecom?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I don't think so. That was the only thing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. Well, just to quickly recap our call: I've applied a $35 credit to your account to offset the activation fee that was charged in error.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will need to pay your current bill as stated, and this credit will automatically apply to your next month's bill, reducing its total amount.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. I understand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you have the reference number for your records.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I wrote it down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. We always want to make sure our customers are on the plans and promotions they were promised.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I appreciate that. It's why I've stayed with you guys for so long.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We value your loyalty, Mr. Gonzalez. It looks like you've been a Cymbal Telecom customer for over eight years now. We truly appreciate your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, has it been that long? Time flies.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It certainly does.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, well, thank you again for fixing that so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Actually, you know what, while I have you... can I ask a quick question about my plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course! I'd be happy to answer any questions you have.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So with the new line, I have two lines on the Unlimited 5G plan now. Is there any kind of multi-line discount that I should be getting?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an excellent question. Let me check the details of your current plan structure. One moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, thank you for waiting. I see you're on the Unlimited 5G plan, which is $65 per month per line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It looks like the multi-line discount for that specific plan begins when you have three or more lines. For two lines, the price is the standard per-line rate.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, okay. So I'd need another line to save any money?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. With three lines, the price per line drops to $55, and with four, it drops to $45. But for two lines, it remains at $65 each.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see. I don't need a third line right now, but that's good to know for the future. Thanks for checking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. It's always a good idea to check. We do have other family plans available, but they might require changing your current data structure. Is that something you'd be interested in exploring?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, not right now. The unlimited plan works well for us. Especially for my son. I just wanted to make sure I wasn't missing out on a discount.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand completely. So, to confirm, you're happy to stay on the current plan structure for now?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, for now this is fine. The main thing was the activation fee, and you've sorted that out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I've added a note to your account detailing our conversation today, including the credit reference number, so if you ever need to call back, any agent can see exactly what we did.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very thorough. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We aim to be. Was there anything else at all, Mr. Gonzalez?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that really is everything this time. Thank you for your patience with my extra question.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all. We're here to help.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so I should expect to see the credit on the bill I get next month, correct? Not the one after?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. Your next billing cycle closes in about three weeks, so the invoice you receive in approximately four weeks from now will reflect that $35 credit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, great. Just wanted to be absolutely sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's always good to be sure. I've double-checked on my end, and the credit is pending and scheduled to apply to your next invoice. Everything looks correct.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, I won't keep you any longer then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. Well, thank you again for your call and for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Jasmine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to call us back. We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Thanks again. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
